note_local: Engines that run models on this computer, and their server connections.
note_remote: Cloud accounts and OpenAI-compatible servers. Keys stay on the gateway; only fingerprints are shown.
note_available: Configured providers available to this Gateway principal. Use their provider ids in Flow nodes and Core capability defaults.
form_description: Gateway stores endpoint details and keys server-side, then exposes this connection as an available provider.
key_placeholder: leave blank to keep existing key
base_url_placeholder: optional; leave blank for provider default
description_placeholder: What this provider is for, who owns it, and when to use it.
visible_models_help: Optional. Use Test to preview discovery, then select models only when this provider should expose a fixed allowlist.
clear_restriction_tip: Serve every model this endpoint exposes (no allowlist)
test_tip: Probe the endpoint and list the models it actually serves
confirm_tip: Store this connection server-side and expose it as a provider
connect_tip: The address workflows use to reach this server; add one for a server on another computer.
delete_confirm: Delete {n}? Existing workflows that select this virtual provider will stop working until they are remapped.
